async def act(page):
    # Scroll within the complementary section to load more archive links
    complementary = page.get_by_role("complementary")
    await complementary.evaluate("element => element.scrollTop = element.scrollHeight")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for lazy loading
    # Try to find and click the 'February 2019' link
    try:
        feb_link = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("link", name="February 2019")
        await feb_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    except Exception as e:
        # If not found, scroll again or raise an error
        await complementary.evaluate("element => element.scrollTop = element.scrollHeight")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        try:
            feb_link = page.get_by_role("complementary").get_by_role("link", name="February 2019")
            await feb_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        except Exception as e2:
            raise Exception("Link for 'February 2019' not found after scrolling the complementary section.")
